item.title: Insiders Agree On One Destination For Oilers' Mangiapane
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers are quickly moving towards a decision on where to trade Andrew Mangiapane. He just hasn't been the right fit in Edmonton since signing a two-year deal at $3.6 million AAV. The contract has trade protection, but the forward is willing to waive his no-trade clause to go to a team with a better opportunity, and it doesn't even have to be a contender.That makes things a lot easier for the Oilers and there is one team that is being agree upon by insiders. That is the Winnipeg Jets

item.title: Oilers Looking To Re-Sign Roslovic
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers have gotten a very strong season from Jack Roslovic that was unfortunately broken up by an injury. Now, with the team healthy, he is being tried out as the third line center, a position that is of need to the Oilers.Roslovic has the fifth-most points among Oilers' forwards and has 12 goals and 20 points in 31 games. item.title: Clayton Keller Calls Out Mammoth Fans for Whistling During Games
item.description: Somebody tell everyone new to hockey in Utah that you don't whistle during a game. Especially collectively over 10,000 of you at a time.
